description.value: E&B Market is a convenience store located on McPhee Avenue, serving the local community with everyday essentials. As a small neighbourhood market, it is a practical stop for touring cyclists needing to resupply. The surrounding area on Vancouver Island is a popular corridor for cycle touring.
